name: Heap
label: Heap — server-side track / identify / properties
description: Official Heap server-side HTTP ingest. Handler: OfficialApiNode. POST /api/track, /api/v1/identify, /api/add_user_properties, /api/add_account_properties. app_id goes in the JSON body (auth type none). region selects the official host (heapanalytics.com or c.eu.heap-api.com). Not heatmap/session-replay export and not browser heap.js. Customer owns the Heap workspace. Minimize properties (no government IDs or health data). Never log identity or emails.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation ingest fields plus app_id (OfficialApiNode bodyFrom reads INPUT only — copy config app_id onto input). track: event and exactly one of identity|user_id. identify: user_id+identity. addUserProperties: identity+properties. addAccountProperties: account_id+properties or accounts[]. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"track","app_id":"11","identity":"ada@example.com","event":"Signup"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'track' | 'identify' | 'addUserProperties' | 'addAccountProperties'.

schema.label: app_id
schema.description: Heap environment ID (Main Production). JSON body app_id. Also set in config; copy onto INPUT so it is posted.

schema.label: identity
schema.description: Case-sensitive identity. Max 255. track: mutually exclusive with user_id.

schema.label: user_id
schema.description: Heap SDK user id (decimal string, 0 … 2^53−1). identify required.

schema.label: properties
schema.description: Heap event or user properties map. track / addUserProperties / addAccountProperties. Example: {"plan":"pro"}.

schema.label: account_id
schema.description: addAccountProperties single account id unless accounts[] is sent.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (Heap often {}). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: track | identify | addUserProperties | addAccountProperties.

configurationParameters.label: App ID
configurationParameters.description: Heap environment ID of Main Production. OfficialApiNode posts it only if also present on INPUT (bodyFrom). Never log next to identities.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: Official ingest host. US: heapanalytics.com. EU: c.eu.heap-api.com (https://developers.heap.io/reference/server-side-apis-overview). Interpolated into baseUrl.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
